extDescription.message: Translate words on web pages and in video subtitles, save them to your vault and review them with quick quizzes.

popupClose.description: Label of the button that closes the translation popup.

popupBack.description: Label of the button that leaves the language list and returns to the translation.

popupSpeak.description: Label of the button that reads the selected word aloud.

popupSourceLang.description: Tooltip of the source-language control and title of the list that opens from it.

popupTargetLang.description: Tooltip of the target-language control and title of the list that opens from it.

popupTranslating.description: Shown in the translation popup while waiting for the translation.

popupAlternatives.description: Prefix of the list of alternative translations, e.g. 'Also: reservation, volume'.

popupTranslatedBy.description: Attribution line in the translation popup. $1 is the name of the translation service.

popupRetry.description: Button shown under an error message in the translation popup.

langAuto.description: Source-language choice that lets the extension detect the language.

langAutoDetected.description: Source-language label when the language was detected automatically. $1 is a language name.

langSearch.description: Placeholder of the search box above a list of languages.

langNoMatch.description: Shown when the language search finds nothing.

sitePin.message: Always use this language on this site
sitePin.description: Checkbox under the source language: remember the chosen source language for the current website.

noteSameLanguage.message: This text already seems to be in your target language ($1).
noteSameLanguage.description: Small informational note under a translation. $1 is a language name. Followed by links to change the source or target language.

linkChangeSource.description: Link that opens the source-language list.

linkChangeTarget.description: Link that opens the target-language list.

firstRunText.message: Translations are made into $1. Is that the language you want?
firstRunText.description: Asked once, until the user has chosen a target language. $1 is a language name.

firstRunConfirm.description: Button: keep the suggested target language.

firstRunChange.description: Button: open the list to pick another target language.

optTargetLang.description: Options page: heading of the target-language setting.

optTargetLangHelp.message: Translations are made into this language. You can also change it from the translation popup.
optTargetLangHelp.description: Options page: explanation under the target-language heading.

optTargetLangCurrent.description: Options page: shows the selected target language. $1 is a language name.

optTargetLangUnset.message: Not chosen yet. Using your browser's language: $1
optTargetLangUnset.description: Options page: shown until the user picks a target language. $1 is a language name.

optDoubleClick.description: Options page: label of the switch for the double-click trigger.

optDoubleClickHelp.message: Double-clicking a word on a page opens the translation popup.
optDoubleClickHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the double-click switch.

optSaved.description: Options page: confirmation shown briefly after a setting is stored.

errNetwork.message: Could not reach the translation service. Check your internet connection.
errNetwork.description: Error: the request failed before any response arrived.

errTimeout.message: The translation service took too long to respond.

errRateLimit.message: The translation service's free limit has been reached. Try again later.
errRateLimit.description: Error: the provider refused the request because of a usage quota.

errUnsupportedLanguage.message: The translation service does not support this language pair. Try picking the languages above.
errUnsupportedLanguage.description: Error: the provider rejected the source or target language.

errTooLong.message: The selected text is too long to translate.
errTooLong.description: Error: the selection exceeds the length limit.

errNoResult.description: Error: the provider returned an empty result.

errContextInvalidated.message: Wordvault was updated. Reload this page to keep using it.
errContextInvalidated.description: Error: the extension was reloaded or updated while this page stayed open.
